body:
PR #2806: S3 (probe/destroy lifecycle) of the BUG-2169 clone design. Refs TASK-2053 (S4/S5 remain).
- seat_clone::probe: runs git inside a read-only, network-less bwrap. If it gets no answer the result is Unknown and the clone is kept.
- salvage: writes a patch into <main>/.aida/salvage/<clone>/.
- destroy: location check, probe, salvage, remove the clone and its target dir, release the pin.
- session end, reap (classify_clone_reap plus orphan-pin release) and worktree dismiss now handle clone leases.
Tests:
- T7 canaries with a host-git shim, plus a negative control.
- T6 stale pin-lock.
- T4 probe check.
- End-to-end session end and dismiss.
- task_2053_bwrap_ added to the live-bwrap CI gate.
No mandate/gate files were touched.
Gates: make check-ci-fast (33 passed), make test-touched (239 passed). CI fully green on c3a2dcccf0.
subject: READY: #2806 TASK-2053 S3 at c3a2dcccf0
